name: Exa
description: Search the web and fetch page content for agents.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to Exa so searches use your team's rate limits instead of the free anonymous profile, and so Exa Agent is available.
methods.label: Sign in with Exa
warnings: Browser sign-in works on its own. Exa Agent (agent_run) requires OAuth or an API key; the anonymous keyless profile has no Exa Agent.
Exa Agent runs are billed usage on your Exa plan. Approve or disable agent_run before letting an agent use it unattended.

methods.whenToUse: Use a restricted customer-owned key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a key in the Exa dashboard and paste it below. A key raises rate limits and enables Exa Agent; the keyless server still works without one. Exa's own instruction for API-key mode is the bare URL without ?login.
methods.label: Use an API key
warnings: Browser sign-in works on its own. Exa Agent (agent_run) requires OAuth or an API key; the anonymous keyless profile has no Exa Agent.
Exa Agent runs are billed usage on your Exa plan. Approve or disable agent_run before letting an agent use it unattended.
